actions.action: Check pot has drainage hole and stems are firm at soil line
Inspect leaf undersides for spider mites
Cut off leaves at base once mostly yellow or brown
Water when top 2-3 inches dry, pour until it drains, empty saucer
Feed lightly with fertilizer after about a month once new leaves appear

reason: The answer blames adjustment stress and never names insufficient light. It says to keep the plant where it is rather than move it to brighter light. It also says not to repot, which delays the fix that worked (a sunnier spot and a chunkier mix with the nursery mesh removed).
